note: One home for item status. unknown = not yet captured on the oracle; open = captured or ours-only, not built. A done item needs gate and evidence. Edit this file, then npm run docs.

items.title: Oracle access: headless Chrome with the owner's login copied from their tab, one lane at a time
State capture: element boxes, tokens and labels to fixtures/states/<id>.json, dated
Turn recorder: the oracle's DOM over time to traces/<id>.json
Gate A: box and token diff, ours against the oracle, report in parity/gate-a.json
Gate B: a recorded turn replayed in ours, report in parity/gate-b.json
Inventory: every visible control, ours against the oracle, to docs/MISSING.md
Feel budgets measured on the oracle and written in QUALITY.md
App shell: TanStack Start; the Barkpark token lives only in server functions
Transcript: user and bot bubbles, grouping, the day and time line
Working line: the bot's mark and what it is doing now
Composer: attach, text, Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks, focus after send
Live reply from /v1/chat/sessions/:id/events
A registered chat host on the owner's Mac runs real claude -p
Left rail: bots, the active one, badge, new chat, apps grid, my avatar
Header: the bot's name pill, centred over the transcript
Right panel: mark, name, Activity and Library tabs, close
Computer card: asleep, waking, working, read from the host heartbeat
Cancel a reply: it stops at once and nothing is left running
Come back later: transcript and Claude session resume after a restart
File card: name and size, readable by the bot
Picture grid with a +N tile; each opens large
Library: what the bot saved, newest first
Approval card: nothing happens until I press
Question card with lettered choices
Activity: open work such as a pull request and its state
The bot's host moves to its own VM; J01, J05 and J06 pass there
The Claude token never reaches Barkpark: grep of DB and logs is empty
First run: greeting, naming, a 'Renamed to' line
Message actions on hover
Right panel extras: Suggested and Voice chat
outOfScope: 0004: voice chat, Share, Add to Slack, routines and app connectors wait for their own decision
